detached_structure.evidence: A small reddish-roofed section on the northwest side of the house, possibly an attached addition or small shed, is partly covered by tree canopy.

signals.notes: The lot has a house with a two-tone roof (brown and reddish) and an asphalt driveway on the southwest side. Dense trees cover the north and west parts of the yard, and the lawn to the east and south is dry and patchy.
